comparisons.bin_note: Low-k selection uses shell means <=0.3 h/Mpc; the second shell extends to 0.3078 h/Mpc.

limitations: Saved densities/projections are float32; saved powers were calculated before quantization.
Particles are not stored at each output. Force/momentum summaries can be checked against saved histories, not rederived from unsaved final particle arrays.

Common initial positions and momenta are reconstructible; no per-run entrance array hashes were originally stored. All available initial density snapshots and momentum statistics are independently checked.
Timing records describe concurrent execution, not a serial performance benchmark.
